grammar.summary: 本课学习表"越狱"的语义群与 dressed in 状态描写。

points.title: 分词作状语复现（dressed/wearing）
points.explanation: Dressed in a black uniform, he looked like... 过去分词短语作方式状语，逻辑主语同主句。

examples.en: He was dressed in a smart black uniform.
examples.cn: 他穿着帅气的黑色制服。

points.title: as 表身份（职业）
points.explanation: worked as a driver = 当司机，as 表"以……身份"，职业场景搭配。

examples.en: He had worked as a driver for ten years.
